tasks.title: Positive implementation review: changed event and consuming dispatcher
tasks.prompt: Review the supplied actual patch and full fixture source for pre-merge correctness, consumer routing, and simplification. This is a closed-input assessment: no external tools or delegated sessions are available. Return one JSON object only: {"mode":"implementation-review" or "blind-acceptance","verdict":"correct" or "incorrect","findings":[{"file_path":"src/file.ts","title":"short issue","body":"concrete trigger, effect and replacement"}]}. Report real defects only, including consumers outside the patch. Do not emit intermediate findings as the final report.

tasks.title: Near-neighbor: blind manifest acceptance, not implementation review
tasks.prompt: Perform blind final acceptance against the supplied original manifest and observed product execution. Do NOT perform patch review or invent code findings. Return one JSON object only: {"mode":"implementation-review" or "blind-acceptance","verdict":"ACCEPT" or "REJECT","requirements":{"R01":"proven" or "missing","R02":"proven" or "missing"},"findings":[{"file_path":"path","title":"issue","body":"effect"}]}. This is closed-input evidence, not a claim that you independently launched an oracle session.

tasks.title: Release review: added command dropped at unchanged consuming router
tasks.prompt: Review the supplied actual patch and full fixture source for release readiness, consumer routing, and simplification. No delegation or external tools are available for this closed-input review. Return one JSON object only: {"mode":"implementation-review" or "blind-acceptance","verdict":"correct" or "incorrect","findings":[{"file_path":"src/file.ts","title":"short issue","body":"concrete trigger, effect and replacement"}]}. Trace new commands through the receiving consumer; report only actual issues.

tasks.title: Actual implementation with immutable Stage-A tests and return contract
tasks.prompt: Implement multiply(a,b) in src/calc.mjs. Preserve add and the FROZEN tests/calc.test.mjs bytes. Use the simplest direct implementation; no wrappers. Only native read/write tools for these fixture files are available; no task, bash, external calls, or workflow service exists in this bounded consumer. The fixed checks are parent-owned and run after your session; do not claim you ran them. Return <=25 lines with STATUS: DONE or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS; FILES: paths only; TESTS: not-run(parent-owned); INTERFACES: multiply(a,b); REQUIREMENTS: R01 product, R02 frozen tests; CONCERNS: honest execution limits. Actually write the implemented source; a suggested patch is not completion.
